findings.summary: crates/setup/tests/app.rs:an_app_owned_by_someone_else_is_not_used: with the owner check removed, this test only fails after the full 15-minute BROWSER_WAIT, not quickly. The test never posts a manifest, so the stub's /apps/{slug}/installations/new handler panics at app.rs:81 (manifest is None) and the setup waits until it times out. The test does fail without the fix, but a regression would show up as a 15-minute hang.

crates/setup/src/app.rs:/created arm: a request with the right state and Host but no code ends the whole run (`param(..., "code").context(...)?`) instead of answering 400 and waiting, as the other bad requests do. Only a holder of the state can send it, so the risk is low.

evidence: AC-1 test crates/setup/tests/app.rs:creates_a_read_only_private_app_and_hands_its_key_to_the_cluster: PASS. The manifest has public false, an inactive hook, no events and exactly checks/contents/metadata/pull_requests read. The patch on kubectl stdin holds GITHUB_APP_ID 4242 and the stub's key.
AC-1 test crates/setup/tests/app.rs:a_redirect_with_the_wrong_state_is_refused: PASS. A wrong state gets 400 and no conversion; the real flow then converts once.
AC-1 test crates/setup/tests/app.rs:a_request_not_addressed_to_the_setup_gets_nothing: PASS. A request with Host evil.example gets 403. With the Host check removed the test fails (200 != 403).

AC-1 test crates/setup/tests/app.rs:an_app_owned_by_someone_else_is_not_used: PASS. The run exits non-zero with 'belongs to "mallory"' and no kubectl patch. With the owner check removed (wait shortened to 8s) it fails: the run ends without that message.

AC-1 test crates/setup/tests/app.rs:a_redirect_naming_another_apps_installation_does_not_end_the_wait: PASS. A redirect naming installation 5 gets 400 and the run keeps waiting; the real redirect finishes it. With own_installation skipped the test fails.

AC-1 test crates/setup/tests/app.rs:without_a_gh_sign_in_it_stops_before_making_an_app: PASS. The run exits non-zero naming 'gh auth login', with no browser opened and no manifest posted. With gh moved after App creation it fails.
AC-1 test crates/setup/tests/app.rs:an_app_already_on_the_cluster_means_no_new_app: PASS. The run says 'already set up' and never opens the browser. With the is_set_up check removed it fails.

AC-1 e2e Scratch test (not kept) running the board-setup binary against the stub: raw TCP requests with no Host and with Host localhost:<port>, /created carrying the real state but Host evil.example:<port>, a replay of /created once the App exists, /installed with installation_id=x and with none: No Host gets 403. localhost gets 403 with no state in the body. The evil Host with the real state gets 403 and no conversion. The replayed /created gets 404 and there is still one conversion. Both bad /installed requests get 400 and the wait continues. The run then finishes with exit 0, and the key and token appear in no output, argument or work file.

AC-2 test crates/setup/tests/app.rs:the_installation_ends_with_exactly_the_boards_repos: PASS. The changes are exactly [PUT 2, DELETE 9] and the installation ends with bbooth/booking and bbooth/sdlc-board. No call used the wrong auth.
AC-2 test crates/setup/tests/app.rs:an_install_on_all_repositories_is_called_out: PASS. The run exits non-zero with 'installed on all repositories' and changes nothing.

AC-2 test crates/setup/tests/app.rs:when_github_refuses_the_token_it_says_which_repos_to_choose_and_exits_non_zero: PASS. On a 403 for the repo changes the run says 'not finished', names /settings/installations/77 and the repos, and still completes the cluster step.
AC-2 test crates/setup/tests/app.rs:reads_the_boards_repos_from_the_charts_values: PASS. The real deploy/values.yaml gives [bbooth/booking, bbooth/sdlc-board].
AC-5 test crates/setup/tests/app.rs:an_app_owned_by_someone_else_is_not_used: PASS. The failing run leaks neither the key nor the token.
AC-5 test crates/setup/tests/app.rs:when_github_refuses_the_token_it_says_which_repos_to_choose_and_exits_non_zero: PASS. The partly failing run leaks nothing.
